metadata.description: Reusable skills and plugins for game production and development workflows.

plugins.name: gamegen
plugins.description: Create 2D, 2.5D and 3D games with shared project preferences, concept art, Blender, Godot and measured validation.

plugins.name: coolify
plugins.description: Operate Coolify through its official CLI for configuration, deployments, logs, services, databases and infrastructure management.

plugins.name: devscout
plugins.description: Discover agent skills and library documentation, maintain Backlog.md plans and write changelogs for development workflows.

plugins.name: safeguard
plugins.description: Review application security and trust and safety risks with evidence-backed findings and practical remediation guidance.

plugins.name: webcraft
plugins.description: Build and improve web applications with React, design guides, accessibility, metadata, rendering performance, screenshots and commit messages.

plugins.name: uxdesign
plugins.description: Critique designs, audit accessibility, manage design systems, write UX copy, plan and synthesize user research and prepare developer handoff specs.

plugins.name: nativeapps
plugins.description: Build native desktop and mobile apps, starting with modern macOS apps in Swift, SwiftUI and AppKit, including project setup, agent-safe test builds, distribution and platform quirks.

plugins.name: agent-fleet
plugins.description: Set up and update portable agent workspaces, coordinate scoped unattended work, and review UI changes with visual evidence.
